query:
WITH inserted AS (
            INSERT INTO scrobble_clients (protocol, name, verified)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
            ON CONFLICT (protocol, name, verified) DO NOTHING
            RETURNING id
        )
        SELECT id AS "id!" FROM inserted
        UNION ALL
        SELECT id FROM scrobble_clients WHERE protocol = $1 AND name = $2 AND verified = $3
        LIMIT 1
